text: {"label":"Anxiety, Panic, and Experiential Avoidance","definition":"Assessment and treatment of anxiety, panic, and fear, including exposure therapy, acceptance-based and contextual behavioral processes such as experiential avoidance, relational accounts of fear, and anxiety-related behavior in autistic individuals.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on general anxiety, panic, and fear rather than obsessive-compulsive disorder, phobias, and tics, depression and behavioral activation, or serious mental illness in psychiatric settings."}
